label: occurred at
description: Where the event took place.

label: organised by
description: Who organised or called the event.

label: involved
description: Who took part, was targeted or was present, as reported.

label: response by
description: Security forces and authorities that acted at the event.

label: led to
description: Causal or sequential link to a later event.

label: part of
description: Sub-event of a larger event or phase.

label: member of
description: Membership or affiliation. Reference may carry a date range.

label: held office at
description: Office or post held. The reference carries the start and end date.

label: succeeded
description: Took over an office from.

label: part of
description: Body inside a larger body.

label: located in
description: Containment: building in district, district in province.

label: reports on
description: The source reports this. Carries the anchor quote.

label: supports
description: The source supports the claim. Carries the anchor quote.

label: disputes
description: The source disputes or debunks the claim. Carries the anchor quote.

label: geolocates
description: A media item verified to show this place.

label: shows
description: What a photo, video or audio item shows or is about.

label: documents
description: The item is evidence for, or the object of, this claim, action or event (including a fact-check of misattributed footage).

label: published in
description: The article or page the item appeared in.

label: geolocated by
description: The investigation or fact-check that established where or when it was recorded.

label: claimed by
description: Who made the claim.

label: concerns
description: What the claim is about.

label: conflicts with
description: Two claims give incompatible accounts of the same fact. Stored once; shown from both ends. Different counting dates or scopes are not a conflict.

label: issued by
description: The body or official that took the action.

label: concerns
description: Who or what the action applies to.

label: in response to
description: The trigger of the action.

label: casualty of
description: The event in which the person was killed or injured.

label: incident at
description: Where the person was killed or injured, as reported.

label: treated at
description: Hospital or facility named in reporting.
